mapper.sql: SELECT f.id AS follow_up_id, f.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, f.owner_member_id, owner.display_name AS owner_name, f.status, f.due_at, f.priority, f.intent_level, f.risk_level, f.reason, f.recommended_action_type, f.recommended_action FROM follow_up f JOIN customer c ON c.organization_id = f.organization_id AND c.id = f.customer_id LEFT JOIN organization_member member ON member.organization_id = f.organization_id AND member.id = f.owner_member_id LEFT JOIN app_user owner ON owner.id = member.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE follow_up SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{followUpId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SNOOZED') AND (owner_member_id IS NULL OR owner_member_id = #{memberId})
